The '''Anteevy system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Esuain sector/Legends|Esuain sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anteevy/Legends|Anteevy]].

Between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of the Anteevy system|conquered]] the system.<ref name="TEA" />
